name: @heyoz/design-system
description: HeyOz design tokens. OKLCH source of truth; emits DTCG JSON for Figma and CSS plus a Tailwind preset for the app. No runtime dependencies.
//type: Deliberately NOT "module". The build files are .mjs, which is already unconditionally ESM, so the field would buy nothing — and it would reclassify dist/tailwind.tokens.js as ESM, breaking the require() that DEV-GUIDE tells devs to put in tailwind.config.js. Verified: with type:module set, require() of that file fails.
//verify:docs: Figures written in prose, checked against the build that produced them. CLAUDE.md rule 5 said 'verify numbers, do not restate them' and nothing enforced it; a single sweep found six wrong figures across four docs, including the Figma token table that had already been wrong twice and carried a note saying so. A note is not a gate. Kept OUT of build.mjs on purpose: the docs it reads are written against the build's OUTPUT, so it has to run after, and 'the one command' stays the token build.
